speaker.name: Automation Alex
speaker.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

output.objection: You are treating my offer to shrink the pipeline budget as a free concession, which it is not. I am asking you to explicitly record that trade in the project log so we do not lose that capacity later.
output.correction: I did not say I would abandon the CI/CD tooling entirely; I said I would pause non critical upgrades to free up hours for the shadow hand off. Do not report that I am cutting my core infrastructure work.
